title: wx pack
description: Modpack for Wexlor server. FPS, beatiful GUI.
body:
⚙️ Wexlor Utility Modpack

A lightweight and optimized modpack made for the Wexlor Server.
It doesn’t add new items, blocks, or mobs — instead, it focuses on improving performance, visuals, and overall gameplay comfort while keeping the original Minecraft feel.

🧭 Features:

🚀 FPS and performance optimization

🎨 Subtle visual and sound improvements

🧰 Quality of life mods (better UI, keybinds, menus, tooltips)

🕹️ Fully compatible with multiplayer — no gameplay changes

💬 Easy to use, stable, and clean setup


🎯 Goal: To make Minecraft smoother, clearer, and more enjoyable — without changing its vanilla mechanics.


---

📦 Recommended for:
Players of the Wexlor Server and anyone who wants a vanilla-friendly experience with comfort and optimization.

🧩 Version: Minecraft 1.21.x
💻 Developed by: Wexlor Team
